AccountLoginStartResponse.description: The URL contains ephemeral OAuth state; deliberately not Debug.

account.description: Email, one-based number in account/read, or a local record ID.

name.description: P2-179 fields; absent from older servers.

startedAt.description: Unix ms when the latest agent turn started.

durationMs.description: How long the latest agent turn took; absent while it runs.

depth.description:
P2-255: the child's `SessionParent.depth`; absent from older
servers and for children spawned before it.

FolderTrustParams.description: GET query or POST body. POST records trust; restricted opens make no write.

path.description: Canonical repository root, or the folder itself outside a repository.

warning.description: A failed lookup opens restricted instead of blocking the session.

id.description: Opaque ID for one session's subscription, independent of process generations.

DiagnosticPosition.description: LSP positions: zero-based lines and UTF-16 code units.

oneOf.description: Live sandbox selection, never persisted or used as a replay cursor.
Live only; seq is zero and does not advance the durable cursor.

method.description: Summary request shape: `prefix` or `transcript`; absent in older events.

oneOf.description: P2-179, on a child session: the user stopped this agent turn.

P2-179, on the parent: a child's list entry after its status, name or
latest turn changed.
Session-only usage; never belongs to the active conversation turn.

depth.description:
P2-255: how deep `spawn_agent` asked the child to look; absent for
children spawned before it.

ContextEstimate.description: Same byte heuristic as context compaction, including message overhead.

startedAt.description:
Unix seconds of `turn.started`. The reducer fills the three times from
event timestamps; absent means unknown (old data).

durationMs.description:
Time worked so far: up to the latest event while the turn runs, the
whole turn once it has ended.

errorCount.description: Errors and warnings in `totalCount`; missing in items saved before P2-135.

agent.description: P2-179: the sub-agent whose result this delivered, with its status.

agents.description: The agents named or started, in the call's order, as last known.

startedAt.description: Unix ms when the call started and how long it took once done.

oneOf.description: P2-179: one call of a sub-agent tool, after Codex `collabAgentToolCall`.

durationMs.description:
Thinking time from `item.started` up to its latest delta, filled by
the reducer; absent means unknown. Not in Codex.

oneOf.description: Structural code search; `matches` is the current page, `totalMatches` all found.
Provider-independent search results; only search is supported, so there is no action.

part.description: Current transcript chunk, starting at 2; absent for a single chunk.

DiagnosticDelivery.description:
Whether a diagnostics item came with the file change's tool result
(`inline`) or arrived later, before another model request (`late`).

result.description: The final reply as given to the model.

CollabAgent.description:
P2-179: a sub-agent named on a `collabAgentToolCall` card or a
`backgroundEvent` that delivered its result, as last known.

CollabAgentTool.description: The four sub-agent tools; names follow Codex's `CollabAgentTool`.

AstGrepMatch.description: One syntax-structure match; line and column are one-based.

WebSearchResult.description: A search result shared by all search providers. Dates are RFC 3339 when known.

ToolContentItem.description: Tool attachments refer to durable copies in the owning session directory.

RestoredFile.description: A file automatically restored after compaction; absent lines means reference only.

request.description: Absent in old events; costUsd is null for unpriced or ChatGPT plan requests.

contextTokens.description: Current context occupancy, distinct from cumulative billed input tokens.

autoCompactTokens.description:
The context occupancy past which the server compacts automatically.
Absent in old events.

billingKind.description: Absent in old records, which retain their costUsd semantics.

prePlanApprovalPolicy.description: Permission mode to restore when the user leaves planning without a selection.

planEnabled.description: Effective tool switch, frozen when the server opens this session.

sandboxEnabled.description:
Whether this session's model commands run in the sandbox, as the server
opened it; absent from servers that do not report it.

restrictedMode.description: Effective folder restriction, determined by the server on open.

SessionSettings.description: Public settings. Environment variables never belong here.

arguments.description: Full tool arguments, including a command or the proposed file changes.

oneOf.description: Live sandbox selection, never persisted or used as a replay cursor.
Live only; seq is zero and does not advance the durable cursor.

method.description: Summary request shape: `prefix` or `transcript`; absent in older events.

oneOf.description: P2-179, on a child session: the user stopped this agent turn.

P2-179, on the parent: a child's list entry after its status, name or
latest turn changed.
Session-only usage; never belongs to the active conversation turn.

sandboxPending.description: Live-only next-turn sandbox state; never restored from stored events.

closeReason.description: Why the session is closed; absent for open sessions and legacy data.

createdAt.description: Unix time in milliseconds; zero until the first event is applied.

approvalFeedback.description: User feedback from declined approvals, keyed by tool item ID.

stoppedByUser.description:
P2-179: the user stopped the latest agent turn (`agent.stopped`);
cleared when another agent turn starts.

InfoResponse.description: GET /v1/info. Each session carries its own replay cursor; there is no global sequence.

RunningTurnsResponse.description: GET /v1/runningTurns. Live work, including scheduled automatic continuation.

ModelListResponse.description: GET /v1/models. The configured catalog is returned in full.

autoCompactTokens.description:
The context occupancy past which the server compacts automatically.
Absent from older servers.

ContextResponse.description: Read-only estimate of the currently loaded context, using the compaction heuristic.

writable.description: cwd, added directories, the session's private temporary directory and caches.

readOnly.description: Readable but never writable, besides Git config and hooks.

network.description:
Whether commands reach the network without a one-command approval,
under the current permission mode.

SessionSandboxResponse.description:
GET /v1/sessions/{id}/sandbox: what this session's model commands may touch
now, worked out on each request. Only `enabled` is meaningful when false.

SessionSandboxParams.description: Change only this opening's sandbox choice, effective from the next turn.

CommandRuleListResponse.description: Global command rules, read from the server's file at `path`.

CommandRule.description: Identifies a command rule by its complete word prefix and decision.

CommandRuleDecision.description: A decision in the server's command rules file. Unknown values are invalid.

FileRuleDecision.description: File rules never grant access; unknown decisions are invalid.

CommandRuleDeleteResponse.description: Result of deleting every exact match. Zero means the rule no longer exists.

SkillListResponse.description: GET /v1/sessions/{id}/skills. Frozen when the session is opened.

sandboxDisabled.description: Disable the sandbox for this opening, regardless of server configuration.

restrictedMode.description: Restrict this opening even if the server has a positive trust record.

SessionCreateParams.description: POST /v1/sessions. Do not log this body: env may contain credentials.

SessionListResponse.description: GET /v1/sessions. Each summary carries its own lastEventSeq.

cwd.description: Exact working directory; absent means every directory.

sandboxDisabled.description: False or omitted follows server configuration, not saved session state.

SessionResumeParams.description: POST /v1/sessions/{id}/resume. Never log this body or replace an open session's environment.

fromSuggestion.description: Accepted via Tab / Right, including a subsequently edited suggestion.

nonInteractive.description: No client will answer requests in this turn. Accepted only while idle.

approvalPolicy.description: Override permissions for this turn only; never changes session settings.

review.description: Present for a read-only review turn; the single-line display title.

SessionInputParams.description: POST /v1/sessions/{id}/input. Idle starts a turn; mode applies when busy.

turnId.description: None while queued for a future turn.

SessionShellCommandParams.description: Run a user command as its own turn, only while the session is idle.

SessionBtwParams.description: An ephemeral question. Its response stream is private to this HTTP caller.

SessionHandoffParams.description: Generate a private handoff note from an idle session's current context.

oneOf.description: Replaces the answer after an attempt is discarded or an item is confirmed.

SessionInterruptParams.description: POST /v1/sessions/{id}/interrupt, with the target turn as a precondition.

SandboxRequest.description: Extra scope for one model command; it never disables the sandbox.

eventSeq.description: The original resolution's sequence when alreadyResolved is true.

rememberSelection.description: Remember an actual model/effort change as the default for new sessions.

expectedName.description: Compare before applying the update; empty means unnamed. Omitted is unconditional.

addDirectories.description: Append directories; never replaces or removes existing directories.

SessionUpdateParams.description:
PATCH /v1/sessions/{id}. Omitted/null scalar fields retain their current values.
Omitted/empty addDirectories appends nothing.
The resulting complete public settings are emitted in session.updated.

SessionCompactResponse.description: Accepted compaction; completion is reported by the referenced turn's events.

lastEventSeq.description: Preview's sequence; required when executing, omitted when requesting a preview.

observe.description: Observe without joining the session's client lifecycle.

EventsParams.description: GET /v1/events?session={id}&after={seq}. Zero requests the complete history.

EventsResponse.description: One SSE data frame, encoded as the event itself (not a JSON array).
